description: Reviewed FormalVerificationDeploymentLock@2: every formerly declared installation gap and incomplete managed pin carries version/license/platform/source/checksum or immutable package-lock identity plus an installer entry. Installs are user-local, explicit opt-in only. Imports, discovery, tests, and offline certification never install, download, open the network, or mutate a system package manager. Unsupported platforms fail closed.

platform_policy.notes: Platforms outside supported_platforms must fail explicitly; they never silently degrade to PATH heuristics.

zkp_deployment_artifact_schema.notes: Shared lock binds public deployment identities only; private witnesses and proving keys remain out-of-band.

hyper_tools.notes: FVT-077 is the objective validation repair that re-proves FVT-G208 and binds the synthetic discovery term objective validation repair. Hermetic engines remain differential-only and never satisfy vendor production evidence.

datalog_secpal_external.notes: FVT-101 is the objective validation repair that re-proves FVT-G217 and binds the synthetic discovery term objective validation repair. Genuine SecPAL artifact intake is transactional and non-executable; the live platform matrix remains empty and cannot promote operator compatibility or fixtures to a vendor engine.

lean_shim_toolchain_mismatch.description: Elan/default selection names a Lean toolchain that is not fully installed offline, so lean/lake on PATH can still trigger a network download during reconstruction.

locked_version_mismatch.description: Observed tool version string does not contain the locked pin version. Hermetic offline certification requires an exact pin match.
